Get your event on this list

Three ways, easiest first: run your events on a public Luma calendar and tell us its address (we'll ingest everything you publish, forever) · submit it to TOA's Luma calendar (admin-approved) · or suggest a one-off event. AI-relevant, Greater Boston, open to the community — that's the whole bar.

A companion to the Mass AI Atlas · sources: community Luma calendars, Luma's Boston AI feed, and AI Tinkerers Boston · aggregation approach builds on nkpng2k's startup-event-scraper (Apache-2.0)
